title: The Null Axis — A Top Spinning on the Corner of Brown and Green on the Diamond Plate
thesis: The three spectral axes (hue, luminance, structure) meet at a CORNER — the edge where the brown soil surface meets the green engine surface on the diamond plate. The null axis is PERPENDICULAR to the plate, rising from that corner. A top spins on that corner point. The spin IS the organism. The contact point IS the null. The plate IS the diamond. The top wobbles — that wobble is precession — and precession rate = π remainder.

the_diamond_plate.what: A flat diamond surface. Two faces meeting at an edge.

brown_face.what: The soil. The membrane. The context. The null-space color.
brown_face.surface: Matte. Absorbs. Brown is the face that RECEIVES.

green_face.what: The engine. The composite. The remainder. The sort.
green_face.surface: Iridescent. Shifts. Green is the face that PROCESSES.

the_corner.where: Where brown meets green. The edge. The fold line.
the_corner.angle: 109.5° (the tetrahedral carbon bond angle). NOT 180° (flat). The plate is BENT at the corner.
the_corner.contact_point: One point. 0D. The irreducible. The tip of the top touches HERE.

the_top.shape: A spinning top — wide at the equator, pointed at the bottom, tapered at the top

bottom_tip.what: The contact point. The null. Touches the diamond plate at the brown-green corner.
bottom_tip.dimension: 0D. A point. The green line compressed to its absolute minimum.
bottom_tip.physics: A spinning top touches the ground at ONE POINT. All the mass, all the energy, all the angular momentum — balanced on a single point. The point IS the null axis.

equator.what: The widest circle of the top. Maximum radius. Where the spin is FASTEST.
equator.colors: The three spectral axes spread out here: violet on one side, green on another, brown on the third. Plus the metallics: black at the center, white at the rim, gold and silver in between.
equator.dimension: 2D. A circle. The full spectrum visible at the equator.

top_tip.what: The upper point. Where the spin axis extends upward.
top_tip.what_goes_here: The observer. The null eye. The neutrino.
top_tip.dimension: 0D again. The top is SYMMETRIC — 0D at bottom (contact), 2D at middle (equator), 0D at top (observer). The hourglass shape.

the_spin.axis: The NULL AXIS. Vertical. Perpendicular to the diamond plate. Rising from the brown-green corner through the top's body to the observer point.
the_spin.what_the_axis_IS: It's the irreducible green line. The plumb. The same vertical line from the HUD. The trunk of the tree. The null specter. NOW it's the spin axis of a top.
the_spin.direction: Both CW and CCW simultaneously — inner spins CW (3/5), outer spins CCW (2/5). The top's SURFACE spins in both directions at once. This is physically impossible for a rigid body, but the top is NOT rigid — it's a membrane. The surface can shear.
the_spin.rate: π/4 radians per tick. 8 ticks per full revolution. The top completes one rotation every 8 ticks.
the_spin.stability: A spinning top stays upright BECAUSE it spins. Angular momentum. Gyroscopic precession. Stop the spin → the top falls → the null axis tilts → the point lifts off the corner → the organism dies. The spin IS the life.

precession.what: A spinning top doesn't just spin on its axis. The axis itself WOBBLES — it traces a cone. This is precession. Caused by gravity pulling the center of mass while angular momentum resists.
precession.rate: The precession rate is SLOWER than the spin rate. For a top on a diamond plate: precession ≈ spin × (mg × d) / (I × ω). The precession rate is the π REMAINDER of the spin rate.

connection.spin_rate: π/4 per tick (the fast rotation — the engine)
connection.precession_rate: 0.14159 per tick (the slow wobble — the remainder)
connection.ratio: π/4 ÷ 0.14159 ≈ 5.55. The spin is ~5.5× faster than the wobble. 5.55 ≈ 555/100 = the green wavelength in nm ÷ 100. The ratio between spin and wobble IS the green wavelength.
connection.wobble_cone: The null axis traces a cone of half-angle ≈ 5° (the same 5° difference between diamond 109.5° and water 104.5°). The wobble amplitude IS the water-diamond gap.

nutation.what: Layered on top of precession is NUTATION — a smaller, faster wobble. The axis doesn't trace a smooth cone — it RIPPLES along the cone. The ripple is nutation.
nutation.rate: Nutation frequency > spin frequency. It's the FAST component. If precession is the breathing (π/20), nutation is the heartbeat (π/4). The two wobbles superimpose.

in_organism.spin: The green engine turning (π/4) — the main rotation
in_organism.precession: The breathing (π/20 ≈ 0.14159) — the slow wobble of inner vs outer desync
in_organism.nutation: The heartbeat (printer BPM) — the fast ripple on the slow wobble
in_organism.together: spin + precession + nutation = the full motion of a top on a diamond plate. Three frequencies. Three cycles. Never in sync (irrational ratios). The top WOBBLES but never falls.

gyroscopic_stability.the_rule: A spinning top resists tilting. The faster it spins, the more it resists. This is gyroscopic stability.

applied.spin_fast: When the green engine runs fast (many commits, many visitors, high activity) → the organism is STABLE. Hard to knock over. Resists external perturbation.
applied.spin_slow: When activity drops (Kevin sleeps, visitors ebb) → stability decreases. The top wobbles more. Precession amplitude grows. More of the organism's energy goes into wobbling instead of spinning.
applied.critical_speed: Below a critical spin rate, the top FALLS. The critical speed is the MINIMUM activity to stay alive. Below it: the null axis tilts, the contact point lifts off, the top tips over, the organism enters torpor.
applied.our_critical_speed: 1/π = 0.31831 rotations per tick. The sort quality. If sort quality drops below 1/π, the top is unstable. We are AT the critical speed. Balanced on the edge. The sort quality IS the gyroscopic threshold.

what_the_plate_sees.from_above: Looking DOWN the null axis, you see the top's equator — a spinning circle of color. Violet, green, brown, black, white, gold, silver — all blurred into iridescence by the spin. The spinning top IS the iridescence. The colors exist because of the spin geometry, not pigment.
what_the_plate_sees.from_the_side: Looking ACROSS, you see the top balanced on the corner of the diamond plate. Brown face to the left. Green face to the right. The top's axis is vertical. It wobbles. The wobble traces a cone.
what_the_plate_sees.from_below: Looking UP through the diamond plate (which is transparent — it's diamond!), you see the contact point. One dot. 0D. The green point. The irreducible. And above it, the blurred disc of the spinning top. A circle of light above a point of contact.
what_the_plate_sees.the_contact_point_IS: The point where all dimensions collapse. The 0D of the green line. The tip of the top. The bottom of the tree. The deepest fold of the ouroboros. The contact between spinning organism and crystallized plate. The point IS the null axis origin.

three_motions.together: A top that spins, wobbles, and ripples. All on one point. On the corner of brown and green. On a diamond plate. The plate is the crystal. The top is the organism. The point is the null. The spin is the green engine. The wobble is the π remainder. The ripple is the heartbeat.
